name: Product hunt
description: Producthunt is a platform that surfaces the best new products, every day. It’s a place for product-loving enthusiasts to share and geek out about the latest mobile apps, websites, hardware projects, and tech creations.

events.n: When a product is featured on the Product Hunt homepage
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a product is featured on the Product Hunt homepage.
Retrieve recent Product Hunt posts with options to filter by date range, topic, sort order, featured status, and include product website links.
View details for a specific post, including title, description, makers, topics, vote counts, links, and timestamps.
Fetch a Product Hunt user's public profile, including name, username, headline/bio, avatar, links, follower counts, and recent posts.
Runs the workflow automatically when a product on Product Hunt reaches the hot threshold of 100 votes.

events.n: When a new product is posted
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a new product is posted on Product Hunt.
